coupling0.note: negative control: with the resource -> payoff coupling set to zero (a model parameter, the kernel update rule is untouched) the strategy trajectories of all arms are bitwise identical under a shared seed, so any fate-round differences must flow through the resource -> payoff channel rather than through task identity or data handling

linear_calibration.note: calibration of the exact first-sweep response on the linear sensitivity prediction across mechanism arms; the slope is expected BELOW one because the full rearrangement leaves the small-perturbation regime (tanh saturation dampens the response); reported, not a pass/fail gate
